# Open Source at Infinite Red

> Documentation for Infinite Red's open source tools for React Native and Node development, all in one place.

Maintained by [Infinite Red](https://infinite.red). Infinite Red is a U.S.-based software development team with over a decade of experience that brings deep engineering knowledge, clear judgment, and collaborative delivery.

## Projects

- [Ignite](https://docs.infinite.red/ignite-cli/): The battle-tested React Native boilerplate, maintained since 2016.
- [Reactotron](https://docs.infinite.red/reactotron/): A desktop app for inspecting your React and React Native projects.
- [React Native MLKit](https://docs.infinite.red/react-native-mlkit/): Use MLKit models in React Native and Expo apps.
- [Gluegun](https://docs.infinite.red/gluegun/): A delightful toolkit for building Node-powered CLIs.
